verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an embedded-payments SaaS platform with a portal and components, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair question to ask. The evidence covers payment components, onboarding, webhooks, Zapier no-code automation and an llms.txt docs file, but nothing describes a built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Because the axis applies and there is no supporting evidence, the verdict is none.
